question: What problem arises if all excluded objects must be grasped simultaneously?
premises: Exclusion of non-pots implies reference to many other objects
Simultaneous grasping would include all such objects
The number of objects in the world is limitless
inference: If grasped simultaneously, pot and other objects would lead to an infinite regress in the world.
plain_english: Or else, if grasped simultaneously, pots and all other objects in the world would become infinite.
